csv_project_name: CMAR For Fisher College of Business Facility Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The project scope and objectives include: 65 total classrooms through both new construction, and selective renovations of Pfahl, Gerlach, Schoenbaum, and Mason Halls. Integration of active learning classrooms and distributed study spaces. Creation of dedicated industry partner space connected to student activity. The project has been approved for design and preconstruction services only. This request is for Construction Manager at Risk ( CM ) to assist with preconstruction to establish the schematic design concept and begin design development. The university may amend the CM contract upon approval for construction documents, bidding, construction contract administration and post-construction services.

title: CMAR for Fisher College of Business Facility Improvements
short_description: University business school improvements with new classrooms and selective renovations in Columbus, Ohio.
project_scope: Facility improvements for the Fisher College of Business at Ohio State University, including 65 total classrooms delivered through a combination of new construction and selective renovations of Pfahl Hall, Gerlach Hall, Schoenbaum Hall, and Mason Hall. The scope also includes integration of active learning classrooms, distributed study spaces, and dedicated industry partner space connected to student activity. At this stage, the project is approved for design and preconstruction services only.
services: Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) services for preconstruction to help establish the schematic design concept and begin design development, with possible later amendment for construction documents, bidding, construction contract administration, and post-construction services.
relevance_explanation:
- University project type is generally of interest to sbp.
- Scope includes building improvements and some new construction, but no notable long-span, special structural, or bridge-related features are described.
- Current procurement is primarily for CMAR/preconstruction rather than structural design services.
- Potential strategic entry exists through early-stage involvement, but the tender is not focused on engineering design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. Useful scope information for a future estimate: 65 classrooms, new construction plus selective renovation of four halls, active learning spaces, study spaces, and industry partner areas; however, no gross floor area, renovation extent, or budget is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is for CMAR preconstruction services, not a structural engineering fee procurement, and there is insufficient budget or area information to derive a realistic sbp fee estimate.
